_comment: Maps Command Center agents (lib/team.ts ids) to the T3 Code provider that answers for them. 'provider' is a list of lowercase substrings matched against the T3 provider's displayName/driverKind from orchestrator_capabilities. Any agent not listed here is treated as NOT CONNECTED and keeps the draft-only box. Edit this file to connect or move agents; no code change needed.

forge.note: Assigned to the single 'Claude' provider. If you'd rather point 'Claude' at Sage, Vision, or Lens, move this block to that agent id.

unassignedProviders.note: On in T3 but not matched to an agent yet. To connect one of the Grok Bot team (thoth, horus, imhotep, care, ref, safety), add e.g. "thoth": { "provider": ["grok titan"], "status": "connected" }.
